| Composer | Years | Notable Works / Contributions | Why They’re Famous |
|----------|-------|------------------------------|--------------------|
| **George Gershwin** | 1898‑1937 | *Rhapsody in Blue*, *An American in Paris*, *Porgy & Bess* | Blended classical technique with jazz idiom; his music became a cultural icon of early 20th‑century America. |
